title: gflags Module

exported_parameters.name: initial
exported_parameters.description: The initial value of global flags bitmap.

exported_functions.name: set_gflag
exported_functions.description: Set the bit at the position “flag” in global flags.

exported_functions.name: reset_gflag
exported_functions.description: Reset the bit at the position “flag” in global flags.

exported_functions.name: is_gflag
exported_functions.description: Check if bit at the position “flag” in global flags is set.

exported_mi_functions.name: set_gflag

parameters.name: bitmask
parameters.description: The parameter value must be a bitmask in decimal or hexa format. The bitmaks has a 32 bit size.

exported_mi_functions.description: Set the value of some flags (specified by bitmask) to 1.

examples.code:
...
$ opensips-cli -x mi set\_gflag 1
$ opensips-cli -x mi set\_gflag 0x3
...

exported_mi_functions.name: reset_gflag

parameters.name: bitmask
parameters.description: The parameter value must be a bitmask in decimal or hexa format. The bitmaks has a 32 bit size.

exported_mi_functions.description: Reset the value of some flags to 0.

examples.code:
...
$ opensips-cli -x mi reset\_gflag 1
$ opensips-cli -x mi reset\_gflag 0x3
...

exported_mi_functions.name: is_gflag

parameters.name: bitmask
parameters.description: The parameter value must be a bitmask in decimal or hexa format. The bitmaks has a 32 bit size.

return_value.description: The function returns TRUE if all the flags from the set are set and FALSE if at least one is not set.

exported_mi_functions.description: Returns true if the all the flags from the bitmask are set.

examples.code:
...
$ opensips-cli -x mi set\_gflag 1024
$ opensips-cli -x mi is\_gflag 1024
TRUE
$ opensips-cli -x mi is\_gflag 1025
TRUE
$ opensips-cli -x mi is\_gflag 1023
FALSE
$ opensips-cli -x mi set\_gflag 0x10
$ opensips-cli -x mi is\_gflag 1023
TRUE
$ opensips-cli -x mi is\_gflag 1007
FALSE
$ opensips-cli -x mi is\_gflag 16
TRUE
...

exported_mi_functions.name: get_gflags

return_value.description: The function gets no parameters and returns the bitmap in hexa and decimal format.

exported_mi_functions.description: Return the bitmap with all flags.
